Name: Booking Holdings Inc
Description: Booking Holdings Inc. is a leading American travel technology company headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut, specializing in an extensive portfolio of online travel fare aggregators and metasearch engines. The company's flagship platform, Booking.com, alongside other prominent brands such as Priceline.com, Agoda.com, and Kayak.com, positions it at the forefront of the global travel marketplace. With a strong focus on innovation and customer experience, Booking Holdings leverages data-driven insights to enhance its offerings, catering to a diverse range of travelers and fostering growth in a competitive landscape. The company remains committed to transforming travel through technology while maintaining a robust financial performance.
Address: 800 CONNECTICUT AVENUE, NORWALK, CT, UNITED STATES, 06854
